review_scope: Full 35-line article read; permission include already reviewed separately. Endpoint links and their referenced API version remain unresolved contracts, not executed mutations. No actual response or exhaustive API coverage certificate.

claims.statement: The article declares fpt, ghec and ghes applicability; feature declarations do not establish actual target endpoint support.
REST protection is described for supported secrets, not all sensitive values or arbitrary API content.
The Create a blob endpoint is explicitly included in the documented REST push-protection scope.
The Create or update file contents endpoint is separately included; blob behavior alone cannot certify this path.
A supported secret in requests to those endpoints is documented to produce a 409 secret-detection error; a generic conflict response alone is not proof of this specific cause.
The documented non-bypass recovery removes the secret from request content before retry; a retry without content review is not completed remediation.
The article documents a distinct Create a push protection bypass endpoint; endpoint existence does not authorize bypass or establish actor eligibility.

The three API contract links select version 2022-11-28; endpoint semantics and permissions require review for that contract and the exact deployed target rather than silent substitution of current defaults.
